snippet.description:
A lot of aspirants wanted to learn Current Affairs from Santosh Kumar Sir, but the earlier program fee was too high for many students.

So, after receiving repeated requests from aspirants, Santosh Sir has introduced a more affordable Current Affairs Pre-Cum-Mains Program 2027, with the fee reduced by ₹10,000.

The program is designed to help UPSC aspirants streamline their Current Affairs preparation for both Prelims and Mains, without having to depend on multiple sources.

If you were looking for Santosh Sir’s Current Affairs classes for UPSC 2027 but the fee was a concern, this new option is worth exploring.

📅 Starts: 3 October 2026
